product_summary: A vertical compliance workflow that uses AI to review documents, but owns approvals, audit history, permissions, and execution records.
observed_facts: The product stores approval history and user permissions.
AI is used for document analysis rather than as the sole system of record.
assumptions: Customers treat the approval history as operationally important.
The workflow is used repeatedly rather than for one-time analysis.

dimensions.reason: AI can commoditize document analysis but not the authoritative approval and audit state.
Better models improve review quality without eliminating the compliance workflow.
Audit history, decisions, and organization-specific context accumulate with every case.
The product participates in review, decision, approval, and recorded outcome.
UI and analysis can be copied, but institutional history and integrations cannot be recreated quickly.
AI does not necessarily create compliance demand, though it increases document volume and automation expectations.
The underlying model can be replaced while the workflow and records remain valuable.
A path to system-of-record value is plausible but still depends on customer adoption and retention.

why: The durable value sits in authoritative workflow state rather than generation alone.
Usage compounds operational history and permissions.
AI progress improves the replaceable analysis layer while leaving the control layer necessary.
biggest_absorption_risk: Document review, extraction, summarization, and recommendation quality may become generic model capabilities.
strongest_defensible_asset: Organization-specific approval history, permissions, and audit records.

survival_design.value_migration: As document analysis becomes cheap, value moves toward trusted decisions, execution, accountability, and historical context.

reality_anchor.explanation: These records reflect legitimate organizational actions that a general model cannot invent.

survival_design.workflow_evolution: Make every review produce an approval state and outcome that becomes context for the next review cycle.
survival_design.ai_distribution_path: Expose permissioned compliance status and actions through APIs/tools so enterprise agents can query or initiate approved workflow steps.

time_to_moat.milestone_or_time: after repeated live cases inside one organization
time_to_moat.prerequisite: customers must route real approvals through the product
time_to_moat.risk_before_moat: a competitor can copy the analysis UI before meaningful workflow history accumulates

survival_design.redesign_recommendation: Treat AI analysis as a replaceable module and make approvals, permissions, audit state, and execution the product core.

decisive_question: Will customers route real compliance decisions through the product, or only use it to generate disposable analysis?
